body:
How much validation coverage is lost through test recognition, command selection and output parsing? Follow-up to #28.

**Current findings:** A predeclared six-PR SAMtools sample contains four PRs adding net Perl test invocations; the pinned recognizer counts zero for all six. All test-path sets agree with retained descriptors, but current diff bytes are not claimed identical to original unretained diffs. SGR normalization passes 12 explicit parser fixtures; two targeting checks reproduce preservation of MNE’s broad path.

**Remaining work:** Next: evaluate general runner/targeting changes and complete execution checks before live recovery claims. Seven synthetic validation cases show the pinned validator accepting six incomplete/error cases; a candidate completion guard rejects them while preserving the complete pair. This is mechanism evidence, not regrading of original tasks.

**Boundaries:** original baselines remain immutable; use only justified general changes and upstream’s built-in model calls, with no added per-task LLM/Codex repair loop. No remote/native jobs or model calls have been launched in this follow-up. Execution requires a checkpointed cumulative allowance; #28’s unused ceiling is not a fresh budget. A mechanism test does not establish task recovery or production readiness.

[Evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0a875d9c899e4a1c4015c1e1ce47c96711ee1745/experiments/32-runner-coverage/sample-findings.json) · [Full comparison scope and success criteria](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0a875d9c899e4a1c4015c1e1ce47c96711ee1745/experiments/32-runner-coverage/issue-scope.md) · [Logbook](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0a875d9c899e4a1c4015c1e1ce47c96711ee1745/experiments/32-runner-coverage/logbook.md). Detailed investigation updates are in comments.
